jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
Pandi, LLC
is an SEC-registered investment adviser (“RIA”) and multi-family office based in Kansas City. We provide portfolio management and investment advisory services for families, individuals, trusts, and institutions, including private foundations and private companies owned by our family clients.
Our advisory services primarily consist of: (a) defining overall investment strategy, (b) setting strategic asset allocation targets, (c) selecting, underwriting, and monitoring specific investments, and (d) ensuring our clients have a holistic view of performance for their investment portfolios. We also provide financial consulting and other related family office services to our clients.
The Director of Technology shall define and lead the execution of the technology strategy, cybersecurity posture, and technology operations for Pandi with a focus on leveraging artificial intelligence to automate workflows across investment operations, compliance, reporting, and client service.
This role ensures that information technology systems, infrastructure, and data platforms effectively support business objectives while meeting the operational, security, and regulatory requirements of an SEC-regulated investment firm as well as the needs of its clients’ technology environments. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with strategic oversight of the technology team. In addition to core infrastructure, network, and security responsibilities, the Director will lead the evaluation, governance, and controlled implementation of emerging technologies, including building internal applications and workflows that leverage existing artificial intelligence (“AI”) platforms, while ensuring their use aligns with confidentiality obligations, compliance expectations, and risk tolerance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and execute an organization-wide technology, cybersecurity, data resiliency, and AI strategy that delivers cost-effective, best-in-class services, including governance and risk oversight across Pandi and multiple client entities, including the Patterson Family Foundation and First Hand Foundation.
Serve as a hands-on technology leader by implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting systems directly while managing, mentoring, and developing the technology team.
Establish and oversee a secure, scalable technology environment leveraging modern cloud productivity, identity, networking, and security platforms to support collaboration, access management, and secure operations in a regulated environment.
Oversee the security of systems, networks, applications, and enterprise data in a cloud-first environment, applying zero-trust architecture and the principle of least privilege across identity, network, and application layers.
Prepare, maintain, and manage annual technology financial plans, including forecasting and cost optimization as well as contract management for technology systems.
Provide regular reporting to Pandi leadership and clients on technology projects, initiatives, security posture, and risks.
Build and maintain data infrastructure—pipelines, warehouses, APIs—that enables advanced analytics and AI integration.
Architect and implement AI-powered workflow automation across core business functions including investment research, portfolio monitoring, compliance reporting, and client communications; stay current on AI developments and proactively identify automation opportunities.
Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster recovery plans, ensuring operational resilience and documented recovery procedures.
Ensure data classification, protection, retention, auditability, and lifecycle management of all enterprise content, including collaboration platforms and AI-enabled systems.
Facilitate and support information technology security audits, reviews, investigations, and ongoing monitoring, leveraging centralized enterprise logging and visibility solutions (e.g., SIEM platforms); continuously improve change management, approval, and documentation processes to ensure controlled, auditable technology changes.
In partnership with the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), maintain acceptable use standards, data handling requirements, and access controls for effective monitoring and oversight of AI usage; ensure IT operations meet SEC regulatory requirements for registered investment advisers.
Develop and maintain relationships with external information technology vendors and service providers and conduct vendor due diligence and ongoing technology risk assessments.
Promote a culture of thorough documentation, security awareness, accountability, and control discipline; lead effective end-user education and timely security awareness training reinforcing secure behaviors and responsible use of technology and AI tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or related field; master’s level degree preferred but not required.
Seven (7) or more years of information technology experience with at least five (5) years managing a technology or technical team.
Demonstrated ability to work hands-on: writing code, configuring systems, and solving problems directly.
Experience implementing AI/ML solutions, workflow automation, or data engineering in a business context.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, security architecture, and modern enterprise technology platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred – any relevant certifications.
Preferred – experience supporting SEC-regulated or highly controlled environments (investment advisors, broker-dealers, financial services, etc.).
Preferred – familiarity with investment management and accounting technology platforms (portfolio management, market data providers, custodian integrations, etc.).

We are more than a health system. We are a belief system.
We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary

The IT Program Manager is responsible for leading and managing a team of senior project managers and project managers to successfully deliver a portfolio of work across OhioHealth care sites.

The portfolio of work includes complex, cross functional system implementations, digital transformations, infrastructure modernization, facility expansions, and cybersecurity programs which align to OhioHealth’s strategic goals.

Working closely with care site operational leadership, clinical stakeholders, physicians, vendor partners, and IT leadership, the IT program manager is responsible for management, oversight, and delivery of the full portfolio of projects. This includes staffing allocation and assignment of portfolio work, management of individual contributor project managers, management of interdependencies among projects, and adherence to overall portfolio governance.

The IT Program Manager contributes to the maturity of Solution Delivery organization by identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and process optimization. The IT Program Manager hires, mentors and coaches project management staff and provides opportunities for expanded responsibilities to enhance career growth.

This position requires exceptional leadership, verbal and written communication skills, knowledge of the healthcare industry and the ability to influence without direct authority across a large, matrixed organization.

This is Remote-OH position, with required in person meetings.

Responsibilities And Duties

Lead a team of project managers and senior project managers in the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and adherence to the Solution Delivery framework. This includes ensuring all project managers develop and maintain project artifacts to support scope, schedule, status communication, budget, and risk management. Lead the team through organizational change, ambiguity, and competing priorities.

Drive alignment between IT project management, vendor project management, and operational leadership for enterprise-wide initiatives.

Manage resourcing needs to support delivery of the portfolio. Interview, hire, and onboard both internal and external project managers. Coach, mentor, and serve as the escalation point for project managers. Creatively solve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate appropriately.

Manage vendor relationships to support project management staffing.

Monitor overall financial performance of the portfolio of projects, partnering with finance to align on overall actual and forecasted capital and operating expenditures.

Establish and facilitate program steering committees and governance, ensuring efficient processes and decision making with effective communication and transparency.

Build trusted partnerships across clinical, operational, financial, design and construction and technical organizations including applications, infrastructure, and security. Partner with product managers, engineers, and business leaders to modernize platforms, enable AI and analytics capabilities, improve customer/patient experiences, and continuously optimize delivery processes

Collaborate with peers to continuously improve the maturity of the Solution Delivery organization. Establish and/or optimize governance structures which promote transparency of project status, risks, and issues, and identification of needed executive decisions. Develop tools to automate manual project management deliverables and processes, improving efficiency.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Alfa Capital Management is a premier capital management firm that delivers high-quality financial services to individual and institutional clients with a focus on precision, innovation, and integrity. The firm offers a broad range of services, including investment and portfolio management, hedge fund solutions, wealth management, financial advisory, and private equity and alternative investment opportunities. Alfa Capital Management combines traditional investment principles with advanced quantitative models and analytics to design data-driven, high-performance strategies. With a disciplined, research-driven approach, the firm emphasizes personalized investment strategies, quantitative risk management, strategic asset allocation, and dynamic portfolio optimization. Its mission is to empower clients through intelligent capital management solutions that support sustainable wealth creation and long-term financial security.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the firm’s overall technology vision, strategy, and execution. This role oversees the design, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support investment management, quantitative research, analytics, and client services. Day-to-day responsibilities include directing IT strategy, managing technology roadmaps, supervising project delivery, and ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with industry regulations. The Vice President of Technology collaborates closely with executive leadership, investment teams, and operations to align technology initiatives with business goals and to drive innovation in data management, automation, and digital client experiences. This role also leads and mentors technology teams, manages vendor relationships, and continuously evaluates emerging tools and architectures to enhance operational efficiency and performance.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, support quantitative research, and guide technology decisions.
Candidates should possess deep Information Technology expertise, including enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data management.
Candidates should possess IT Strategy experience, with a track record of defining technology roadmaps that align with organizational objectives.
Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to oversee multiple initiatives, manage timelines and budgets, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Candidates should possess Strategic Planning skills to connect technology investments with long-term business growth and operational resilience.
Extensive leadership experience in technology roles within financial services, asset management, or fintech is highly beneficial.
Experience with quantitative platforms, trading systems, analytics tools, and data governance frameworks is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CISSP, CFA Institute-related programs) are preferred.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and remote team leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs

Compensation:
(US Pay Range: $88,277 - $103,222/yr; UK Pay Range: £49,598 - £60,040/yr) Posted pay ranges apply to US-based candidates. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:

Company Description
Alfa Capital Management is a premier capital management firm that delivers high-quality financial services to individual and institutional clients with a focus on precision, innovation, and integrity. The firm offers a broad range of services, including investment and portfolio management, hedge fund solutions, wealth management, financial advisory, and private equity and alternative investment opportunities. Alfa Capital Management combines traditional investment principles with advanced quantitative models and analytics to design data-driven, high-performance strategies. With a disciplined, research-driven approach, the firm emphasizes personalized investment strategies, quantitative risk management, strategic asset allocation, and dynamic portfolio optimization. Its mission is to empower clients through intelligent capital management solutions that support sustainable wealth creation and long-term financial security.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the firm’s overall technology vision, strategy, and execution. This role oversees the design, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support investment management, quantitative research, analytics, and client services. Day-to-day responsibilities include directing IT strategy, managing technology roadmaps, supervising project delivery, and ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with industry regulations. The Vice President of Technology collaborates closely with executive leadership, investment teams, and operations to align technology initiatives with business goals and to drive innovation in data management, automation, and digital client experiences. This role also leads and mentors technology teams, manages vendor relationships, and continuously evaluates emerging tools and architectures to enhance operational efficiency and performance.

new_jobs.title: IT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
